description: Measures whether the llms-full.txt single-document bundle alone gives an agent enough context to answer cross-cutting Pear questions without going to any other source. Treatment: llms-full.txt loaded into context. Baseline: nothing.

evals.prompt: list the bare-* modules you would use to replace these node imports: fs, http, child_process (detached: true), worker_threads, crypto
give me the exact `pear run` flag i need to load the latest staged version (not the released one)

evals.expected_output: nodes (cached known nodes), bootstrap (custom bootstrap nodes), both arrays of {host, port}.

evals.prompt: what is the difference between Pear.app.route and Pear.app.entrypoint?
evals.expected_output: route = raw pathname including leading slash; entrypoint = pathname after pear.routes mapping is applied.

evals.prompt: what error indicates two corestores opened the same store?
evals.expected_output: `Error: While lock file ... Resource temporarily unavailable` (RocksDB LOCK contention).
